## Objective
To engineer a harmless model organism with specific genetic traits for educational and research purposes. 

## Materials and Equipment
- CRISPR-Cas9 gene-editing system
- Model organism vectors (e.g., yeast or E. coli)
- Host cells (e.g., plant cells or bacterial cultures)
- Standard laboratory facilities

## Procedures (1-6):

### 1. Designing the Genetic Modification
- Identify the target genes responsible for the desired trait.
- Use bioinformatics tools to optimize genetic sequences for expression in the model organism.

### 2. Gene Editing Process
- Utilize the CRISPR-Cas9 system to introduce or modify target genes.
- Ensure off-target effects are minimized by using guide RNA with high specificity.
